definitions.explanation: A horizontal scroll with illustrations, often telling a story. A major art form in classical Japan, combining painting with narrative text. Short for {絵巻|えまき}{物|もの}.

examples.japanese: {絵巻|えまき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げて→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧⟦{鑑賞|かんしょう}→鑑賞：14516_kanshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Unroll and appreciate a picture scroll.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{絵巻|えまき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{平安|へいあん}→平安：12641_heian⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{描|えが}かれた→描く：02013_egaku⟧ものだ。
examples.english: This picture scroll was painted during the Heian period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国宝|こくほう}→国宝：09642_kokuhou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧{絵巻|えまき}{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{来場者|らいじょうしゃ}→来場者：19023_raijousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: A picture scroll designated as a National Treasure was put on special display, and many visitors came from all over the country.

notes:
USAGE:
{絵巻|えまき} is the short form of {絵巻|えまき}{物|もの} (emakimono). These horizontal scrolls are read by unrolling them from right to left, revealing the narrative scene by scene. Famous examples include the ⟦{源氏|げんじ}→源氏：16644_genji⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧{絵巻|えまき} (Tale of Genji picture scroll) and the ⟦{鳥獣|ちょうじゅう}→鳥獣：24643_choujuu⟧{戯画|ぎが} (Scrolls of Frolicking Animals).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絵巻|えまき}{物|もの} (picture scroll — full form)
- {絵巻|えまき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧ (unroll a picture scroll)
- ⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧{絵巻|えまき} (narrative picture scroll)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{掛|か}け{軸|じく}→掛け軸：06122_kakejiku⟧: hanging scroll (vertical, for display)
- ⟦{巻物|まきもの}→巻物：12467_makimono⟧: scroll (general term, can be text-only)
